# TCPShield Mod - Latest Build

**Build Date:** 2026-11-09T14:31:00-06:00

## Available Minecraft Versions

This build includes support for Minecraft versions from 1.16 to 26.3

## Installation

1. Download the JAR file for your Minecraft version
2. Place it in your `mods` folder
3. Make sure you have Fabric Loader installed

## Features

- Gives you the real IP address of players connecting through TCPShield
- Allows blocking direct connections to your server from non-TCPShield IPs

## Caveats

- This doesn't support Geyser, I didn't add it in and don't know if I will.
